az85-poker-chip-biltmore.title: AZ.85, behind the red doors
az85-poker-chip-biltmore.theMove: Order the AZ-85 old fashioned. Ask about the 13th floor.
az85-poker-chip-biltmore.getIn: Red steel doors inside the Biltmore. You need a poker chip.
az85-poker-chip-biltmore.clue: Coral Gables. Red doors, poker chip.

venetian-pool-weekday-opening.title: Venetian Pool at opening
venetian-pool-weekday-opening.theMove: Book online. Be at the gate at 11 on a weekday.

matheson-atoll-pool-morning.title: Matheson's atoll pool
matheson-atoll-pool-morning.theMove: Weekday morning, $7 parking. Swim with a friend.
matheson-atoll-pool-morning.why: A calm bay lagoon off Old Cutler.

mangrove-through-jrk.title: Mangrove, through Jrk!
mangrove-through-jrk.theMove: Oxtail, Lobsta' Mac, a Red Red Wine. Stay for the DJ.
mangrove-through-jrk.why: No sign. You walk through the counter.
mangrove-through-jrk.getIn: Enter Jrk! at 95 NW 1st St and walk to the back.

the-corner-4am-drink.title: The Corner at 4am
the-corner-4am-drink.theMove: Skip the club line. Sit at the bar. Open till 7 on weekends.
the-corner-4am-drink.why: A real bar when the clubs let out.

club-space-terrace-sunrise.title: Sunrise on the Space terrace
club-space-terrace-sunrise.theMove: Get in after 11. Stay for the 7am set.
club-space-terrace-sunrise.why: Everyone knows Space. Few stay for daylight.

kaona-room-tiki-night.title: Kaona Room tiki
kaona-room-tiki-night.theMove: Go Wed or Thu. Start with anything on the house orgeat.
kaona-room-tiki-night.why: The one tiki bar locals point to.

macs-club-deuce-100.title: Mac's Club Deuce
macs-club-deuce-100.theMove: Bring cash. Grab a stool under the neon.
macs-club-deuce-100.why: 100 years old in 2026. The realest room on the Beach.

monterrey-bar-record-room.title: Monterrey Bar on vinyl
monterrey-bar-record-room.theMove: Friday or Saturday. Order a Paper Plane. Book on Resy.
monterrey-bar-record-room.why: A windowless room in a Belle Isle spa.

las-olas-305-cafecito.title: 3:05 at Las Olas
las-olas-305-cafecito.theMove: Cafecito at the window. Cubano to go for the beach.
las-olas-305-cafecito.why: A real ventanita on the Beach.

casa-rassi-pour-over.title: Casa Rassi pour-over
casa-rassi-pour-over.theMove: Pour-over in a wine glass and the brûléed french toast.
casa-rassi-pour-over.why: The best new coffee on the Beach.

panamericano-ring-the-bell.title: Ring Panamericano's bell
panamericano-ring-the-bell.theMove: Reserve, ring, let the bartender pick.
panamericano-ring-the-bell.getIn: Behind Novecento, 2nd floor, #260. Press the buzzer.

simpson-park-hammock-walk.title: Simpson Park hammock
simpson-park-hammock-walk.theMove: Walk the half-mile loop. Free tours weekends 10:30.
simpson-park-hammock-walk.why: Old Brickell forest, blocks from the towers.

dominoes-maximo-gomez-park.title: Morning dominoes, Calle Ocho
dominoes-maximo-gomez-park.theMove: Weekday mid-morning. Watch from the benches.

cafe-la-trova-back-bar.title: Café La Trova daiquiri
cafe-la-trova-back-bar.theMove: Sit at the bar for the band. Order the daiquiri.

sanguich-cubano-lunch.title: Sanguich cubano
sanguich-cubano-lunch.theMove: Before noon. Order the cubano. Eat it hot.

zeyzey-bungalow-dance.title: ZeyZey's backyard
zeyzey-bungalow-dance.theMove: Fri or Sat after 11, when the yard is full.
zeyzey-bungalow-dance.why: A bungalow that feels like a house party.

sweat-records-dig.title: Dig at Sweat Records
sweat-records-dig.theMove: Weekday afternoon. Ask staff which Miami artists to buy.
sweat-records-dig.why: Miami's indie record store, 20 years in.

magic-13-backyard-saturday.title: Magic 13 backyard
magic-13-backyard-saturday.theMove: Saturday or Sunday after noon. Table under the tree.
magic-13-backyard-saturday.why: A brewery for neighbors, not influencers.

sunnys-martini-at-opening.title: Sunny's at 5:15
sunnys-martini-at-opening.theMove: No reservation? At the door by 5:15. Martini, ice cold.
sunnys-martini-at-opening.why: Walk-ins who show up early get in.

kaiju-mezzanine-cocktails.title: Bar Kaiju upstairs
kaiju-mezzanine-cocktails.theMove: Second floor of The Citadel. Order the Kappa.

conventillo-hidden-patio.title: Conventillo's back patio
conventillo-hidden-patio.theMove: 6 to 8 happy hour. Order from the kitchen next door.
conventillo-hidden-patio.getIn: Walk past Battubelin to the bar in back.

el-bagel-morningside-picnic.title: El Bagel, then the bay
el-bagel-morningside-picnic.theMove: At 8, order the King Guava. Eat it in Morningside Park.
el-bagel-morningside-picnic.why: Miami's own bagel. It sells out.

legion-park-saturday-market.title: Legion Park market
legion-park-saturday-market.why: A real farmers market on the bay.

lagniappe-weeknight-backyard.title: Lagniappe on a Tuesday
lagniappe-weeknight-backyard.theMove: Arrive 8:30. Bottle from the fridge, table under the lights.

zak-the-baker-early.title: Zak the Baker at 7:30
zak-the-baker-early.theMove: Croissant or babka, before the Wynwood crowd.

dantes-hifi-listening-seat.title: Dante's HiFi late seating
dantes-hifi-listening-seat.theMove: Book the 90-minute seat on Tock. Order wasabi peas.
dantes-hifi-listening-seat.why: A listening bar about the music.

coyo-taco-back-lounge.title: Coyo Taco's back room
coyo-taco-back-lounge.theMove: After midnight: tacos up front, then the back door.
coyo-taco-back-lounge.getIn: The 'employees only' door at the back.

ica-miami-free-afternoon.title: ICA Miami, free
ica-miami-free-afternoon.theMove: Book a free timed ticket. Weekday afternoon.

jass-kitchen-candlelit-jazz.title: Jass Kitchen by candlelight
jass-kitchen-candlelit-jazz.theMove: Book for 8, when the music starts.
jass-kitchen-candlelit-jazz.why: Live sets, real candles, a table you can book.

rubell-3pm-free-tour.title: Rubell's 3pm tour
rubell-3pm-free-tour.theMove: Ticket ahead. Be there by 2:45. Cards only.
rubell-3pm-free-tour.why: The guided tour is free with entry.

cape-florida-lighthouse-climb.title: Climb the 1825 lighthouse
cape-florida-lighthouse-climb.theMove: Tower tours 10 to noon. Look south for Stiltsville.

the-cleat-no-name-harbor-sunset.title: The Cleat at sunset
the-cleat-no-name-harbor-sunset.theMove: Get through the park gate before dusk. Table on the sand.
the-cleat-no-name-harbor-sunset.why: The best sunset seat in the city.

donut-gallery-teds-special.title: Ted's special, Donut Gallery
donut-gallery-teds-special.theMove: Counter stool at 7. Order the Ted's special.

virginia-key-beach-sunrise.title: Virginia Key at 7am
virginia-key-beach-sunrise.theMove: Be at the gate at 7. Swim before the heat.
virginia-key-beach-sunrise.why: Miami's historic Black beach, quiet at dawn.

deering-estate-mangrove-morning.title: Deering Estate mangroves
deering-estate-mangrove-morning.why: Old Miami, far from the crowds.

barnacle-house-tour.title: The Barnacle, 1891
barnacle-house-tour.theMove: Bring $2 cash. Take the 10am house tour.

maes-room-courtyard-martini.title: Mae's Room martini
maes-room-courtyard-martini.theMove: Come early, everyone sits. Order the burger from next door.
maes-room-courtyard-martini.why: A tiny courtyard den behind Chug's.

katana-sushi-boats.title: Katana sushi boats
katana-sushi-boats.theMove: Put your name down at 5:30. Plates by color.
katana-sushi-boats.why: A line worth joining on Normandy Isle.

manolo-rene-24h-colada.title: Manolo & Rene, 24/7
manolo-rene-24h-colada.theMove: Colada and a cubano, before doors or at 4am.
manolo-rene-24h-colada.why: On 3rd Ave since 1977. Blocks from Kaseya.

cafe-fenicia-muhammara-mixed-grill.title: Café Fenicia, slowly
cafe-fenicia-muhammara-mixed-grill.theMove: Muhammara, mixed grill, coffee brewed in hot sand.
cafe-fenicia-muhammara-mixed-grill.why: A Lebanese room built for lingering.

pho-nam-bun-bo-hue.title: Phở Nam on Flagler
pho-nam-bun-bo-hue.theMove: Viet pizza, then bún bò huế. Thu to Sun.

river-oyster-bar-happy-hour.title: $2 oysters at The River
river-oyster-bar-happy-hour.theMove: Bar seat, 3 to 7pm. Oysters and a La Tropical.

lung-yai-one-order-thai.title: Lung Yai at 5
lung-yai-one-order-thai.theMove: Come with everyone. Order once: som tam, khao soi.
lung-yai-one-order-thai.why: Tiny, strict and worth the rules.
lung-yai-one-order-thai.getIn: No reservations. Whole party present, one order.

palma-candlelit-counter.title: Palma's counter
palma-candlelit-counter.theMove: Counter seat, tasting menu, half-pour pairing.

la-casita-vaca-frita.title: La Casita vaca frita
la-casita-vaca-frita.theMove: Vaca frita with yuca and mojo. Mariquitas for the table.
la-casita-vaca-frita.why: A family Cuban dinner without the line.

krus-kitchen-coconut-rice.title: Krüs Kitchen
krus-kitchen-coconut-rice.theMove: Natural wine. Ask if the smoked coconut rice is on.
krus-kitchen-coconut-rice.why: The Grove at its most grown-up.

hometown-bbq-beef-rib.title: Hometown beef rib
hometown-bbq-beef-rib.theMove: Split a beef rib and brisket. Get the Frito pie.
hometown-bbq-beef-rib.why: Around the corner from the Rubell.

naomis-garden-jerk-chicken.title: Naomi's back garden
naomis-garden-jerk-chicken.theMove: Jerk chicken and pikliz. Eat in the garden.
naomis-garden-jerk-chicken.why: A Haitian counter with a hidden garden.

fiorito-empanada-choclo.title: Fiorito
fiorito-empanada-choclo.theMove: Empanada de choclo, then share an Angus cut.
fiorito-empanada-choclo.why: Open Mon and Tue when others aren't.

bar-bucce-shrimp-pie.title: Bar Bucce shelf wine
bar-bucce-shrimp-pie.theMove: Pull a bottle off the shelf, $20 corkage. Shrimp pie.
bar-bucce-shrimp-pie.why: Wine shop, market and pizza bar in one.

tacos-maria-zeyzey-late.title: Tacos María at 1am
tacos-maria-zeyzey-late.theMove: Off the dance floor: chicharrón tacos and esquites.

double-luck-crab-rangoon.title: Double Luck
double-luck-crab-rangoon.theMove: Crab leg rangoon. They set the orange chicken on fire.

locura-marina-ceviche-sampler.title: Locura Marina ceviche
locura-marina-ceviche-sampler.theMove: Ceviche sampler, rocoto first. Share everything.

marcs-bianca-normandy-isle.title: Marc's Bianca pie
marcs-bianca-normandy-isle.theMove: Artichoke, then the Bianca on sesame crust.

vinya-key-biscayne-skirt-steak.title: Vinya off the beach
vinya-key-biscayne-skirt-steak.theMove: Happy hour at 4, then skirt steak. Bottles at retail.

la-sandwicherie-3am-napoli.title: La Sandwicherie at 3am
la-sandwicherie-3am-napoli.theMove: The Napoli. Drown it in vinaigrette.

broken-shaker-griot-backyard.title: Broken Shaker backyard
broken-shaker-griot-backyard.theMove: Happy hour at 5. Griot with pikliz.

saxony-bar-faena-late-jazz.title: Saxony Bar after 10
saxony-bar-faena-late-jazz.theMove: Dress up. Classic cocktail. Stay for the DJ.
saxony-bar-faena-late-jazz.getIn: Basement of the Faena. Book on SevenRooms.
